The ManxSPCA is the only animal rescue centre on the Isle of Man. 
We are not funded by government and rely purely on donations. 
This YouTube account is for us to share some of the work our fantastic team get up to. 
You can support our charity (no'26a) from home by sharing our videos, our social media uploads or donating through our PayPal via the link below.
https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/manxspca/
